_comment: Turn-event tracking: read ATTACKED_WITH_WEAPON_TWICE_OR_MORE — private flag(s) nothing set. Attacks and token creation are now recorded by the engine and read via EVENT_THIS_TURN. "Target WEAPON attack" -- the ability had no target filter at all, so it pumped ANY attack, not just a weapon attack. Found by sweeping cards whose text says "target weapon attack" for an ability with effects and no weapon filter.
